Captain Silvo, i-is that you?''"
"''Benjar Pranic, you old blood.''"
"''Brutus let you out, did he? Here, come sit with your old crewman. Have some tea and tell me your troubles.|Benjar Pranic and Silvo|audio=Pranic-Silvo-OldBlood-SC3.flac|}} '''Benjar Pranic''' was an [[Ishi Tib]] [[pirate]] that served in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] during the [[New Republic Era]] and then Captain [[Brutus]] following a [[Silvo's pirate raid|mutiny]] against Silvo around [[9 ABY]]. Pranic was surprised to run into Silvo in a [[Unidentified droid repair shop|droid repair shop]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] when the former captain was due to soon face trial but greeted Silvo and offered to chat over [[tea]]. The former captain refused, explaining he was leaving to [[Mission to At Attin|find]] a [[At Attin|new treasure]] and asking the Ishi Tib not to tell anyone about their meeting. However, Pranic sounded the alarm without hesitation, although Silvo then successfully [[Escape from Port Borgo|escaped]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Now, why is it he decided to let you loose right before your trial?''"
"''I let myself loose. I just might have finally found the big score I always talked of.''"
"''Oh, that's interesting. Wouldn't have nothing to do with those children what showed up, eh, pockets full of sparkling dataries.|Benjar Pranic and Silvo||audio=ILetMyselfLoose.mp3}} [[File:Pranic-Silvo-Conversation-SC3.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The Ishi Tib Benjar Pranic and an unmasked Captain Silvo stand facing each other in a droid shop in Port Borgo. The inactive form of SM-33 lies between them in the foreground.|Benjar Pranic served under the pirate Captain Silvo until he was deposed in a mutiny.]] Benjar Pranic was an [[Ishi Tib]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[pirate]] in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] until the [[Shistavanen]] pirate [[Brutus]] [[Silvo's pirate raid|mutinied]] against Silvo and [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] him in the [[brig]] of the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]] around [[9 ABY]].{{SkeletonCrewDate}} He remained in the crew under Brutus on the asteroid, where the crew also captured [[Skeleton Crew|four]] [[Youngling|children]] carrying [[Galactic Credit Standard|Old Republic dataries]] in the brig. Shortly after the children were captured, the Ishi Tib was surprised to find Silvo while dropping off a [[droid]] [[Limb|leg]] in a [[Unidentified droid repair shop|droid repair shop]]{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}} in the port not long before the former captain was to be put on trial by Brutus. The Ishi Tib called out to the captain as he was loading the droid [[SM-33]] onto a [[Repulsorcart|hovercart]], causing the former captain to pull out a [[blaster pistol]] before he realised it was Pranic. Instead of attacking, Silvo greeted Pranic, who suggested the former captain sit down and share his troubles over a cup of [[tea]]. Silvo refused, revealing that he had to borrow the droid and leave in order to [[Mission to At Attin|track down]] a [[At Attin|large score]]. [[File:Pranic-Silvo-Leaving-SC3.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Benjar Pranic stands with a cup of tea behind Captain Silvo, who is pushing a cart carrying the inactive SM-33 out of the door of a droid shop in Port Borgo.|Despite his opinion of the captain, Pranic felt his escape should be reported.]] Pranic complemented the former captain and surmised that Silvo's new scheme likely related to the captured children, which Silvo did not confirm, asking that his former crewmate not mention their run-in to anyone as he prepared to leave the shop. Pouring a cup of tea and standing, Pranic pointed out that Silvo's escape should be reported to Brutus, suggesting they call the guards in for a chat. He then did not hesitate to sound the alarm. Despite pirate pursuit, Silvo nonetheless managed to [[Escape from Port Borgo|escape]] from Port Borgo with the children. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Oh, I have to shove off. I'm borrowing this droid.''"
"''Ah. Always a fire in your belly and a mad scheme in your heart. ''[chuckles]'' Eh, Brutus ain't half the captain you were. You're the best skipper I ever had.|Silvo and Benjar Pranic|audio=Silvo-Pranic-BestSkipper-SC3.flac|}} By the [[time]] Pranic found Silvo in the repair shop, the [[Color|green]]-skinned Ishi Tib was considered old and walked with a [[cane]]. He had respect for Silvo's mad schemes and was able to divine the entirety of the former captain's plan when he encountered him with SM-33 and admired it. The Ishi Tib told Silvo that he was the best captain they had served under and twice the leader Brutus was, admiring his courage and wild schemes. However, the Ishi Tib did not agree to let Silvo escape without telling anyone and did not hestiate in alerting Brutus's men. ==Equipment== During the meeting with Silvo, Pranic wore a brown padded [[Clothing|longcoat]] over a gray shirt and pants with brown [[boot]]s and a gray [[harness]]. He used a [[B1-series battle droid]] leg as a walking cane. ==Behind the scenes== Benjar Pranic was voiced by [[Alfred Molina]] and portrayed by performance artist [[Alexander Ward]] in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} The character was named by one of the show's writers in reference to [[w:c:greatestgen:Benjamin Ahr Harrison|Benjamin Ahr Harrison]] and [[w:c:greatestgen:Adam Pranica|Adam Pranica]], the co-hosts of "[https://maximumfun.org/podcasts/greatest-generation/ The Greatest Generation]" [[Wikipedia:Star Trek|Star Trek]]-themed podcast. Pranica's line "You're the best skipper I ever had." also closely resembles the phrase "Best boss I ever had." which is the response given by fans of the podcast to the question "Are you a friend of [[w:c:memory-alpha:Robert DeSoto|DeSoto]]?" as a way of recognizing fellow fans.{{YouTube|video=eU9kpxLrHEA|text=Benjar Pranic: An Origin Story|channel=GreatestTrek|name=The Greatest Generation|date=2024-12-20}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{ThisWeek|kpmetxxrzwQ|Dispatch: Escape From Port Borgo}} *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#107 - Benjar Pranic|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/236353444956}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Benjar Pranic}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Benjar Pranic |ja=ベンジャー・プラニック |ka=ბენჯარ პრენიკი |nl=Benjar Pranic }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Pranic, Benjar}} [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Ishi Tib]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Silvo's pirates]]
